Mathematics
Graduate Applications
2026-2027 cycle · Fall 2027 entry
A source-linked application dossier for John
UChicago mathematics undergraduate · international applicant currently in F-1 status
164 institutional/program dossiers · United States: 112 · Canada: 13 · Europe: 30 · Asia: 9
Research checked 5 November 2026. Current-cycle facts, standing rules, older-cycle evidence, conflicts and
unresolved details are distinguished throughout. A recent crawl date does not establish that a page applies to
Fall 2027.
Start with the school index, deadlines by school, exact GRE policies or the faculty index.
Public eligibility does not establish admission probability or an individual funding offer. The live program form and eventual offer
control where public sources leave details open.

How to use this dossier
Every school retains all 44 research fields. Exactly identical answers within one section share a text block with
every field label retained. The GRE comparison groups only exactly identical policy text and status; it never
recategorizes a conditional rule.
Names and page numbers in the school index are clickable. PDF bookmarks also reach schools, sections and
individual faculty. Each school links to its deadlines, tests, letters, writing, funding, faculty and sources.
Bracketed source IDs reach that school’s bibliography. Every page links back to the school and faculty indexes;
the school name in the footer returns to the current school’s beginning.
Label
Meaning
[2027 confirmed]
Explicit current-cycle / Fall 2027 evidence. In a mixed field, this may apply only to the
part identified in the wording.
[Standing rule]
An official standing or undated rule. Do not infer a 2027 deadline from a recurring
month and day.
[Prior cycle]
Prior-cycle evidence. Stipends and deadlines retain their stated year.
[Unresolved]
The public sources checked did not establish this detail. This does not mean “not
required.”
[Conflict]
Conflicting official sources or incompatible versions. Both accounts and the unresolved
question remain visible.
Applicant assumptions
Your bachelor’s will be completed before matriculation. Your final graduation date, GPA, citizenship and
complete attendance history were not independently verified. F-1 describes current US immigration status; it
does not establish citizenship, Canadian residency, European fee status or eligibility for citizenship-restricted
scholarships.
Prompts and inaccessible forms
Short prompts are quoted when available. Longer prompts are labeled as paraphrases and linked to the
complete official wording. Missing public limits and portal-only questions remain unresolved. Upload
permission is not inferred from silence. No application accounts, submissions or referee invitations were
created.
Faculty evidence and corrections
Faculty are grouped by mathematical fit, with institutional affiliation and individual publication evidence. Dates
distinguish original preprints, revisions, online publication and journal years. A current appointment or relevant
paper does not prove availability for a new 2027 student. Earlier evidence and audit corrections are retained
and labeled as history; an earlier superseded statement should not be treated as the current conclusion.

Scope and ranking basis
Scope: 164 program dossiers, comprising 112 US, 13 Canadian, 30 European and nine Asian entries. This is the
complete recovered research set, not a claim that every possible relevant overseas program has been
covered. The US set combines a prior top-100 mathematics baseline, current institution-level ranking evidence
and additional programs. A complete accessible current U.S. News mathematics table could not be
independently certified; the current top-100 boundary and ties remain qualified. Do not interpret additional
schools as current top-100 entries. In particular, an earlier inferred thirteen-way tie at rank 93 was not
established. Canada includes a ranking-based shortlist with tied bands plus additional programs; Europe and
Asia are selected for the applicant's research areas and realistic degree routes. Each dossier preserves its
ranking/scope note. Multiple master's, doctoral and scholarship routes at one institution may have different
eligibility and dates.
Applicant: international student completing a UChicago mathematics bachelor's degree, assumed before the
program's required start date. Citizenship, exact graduation date, GPA and full academic history were not
independently verified. F-1 is a US immigration status, not citizenship or eligibility for restricted awards.
Research was principally checked 5 November 2026. A standing or earlier-cycle instruction is not silently
represented as a confirmed 2027 rule.
One preparation file, several school-specific versions
Prepare a master inventory of every institution attended; official and application-copy transcripts; expected
degree date; advanced mathematics courses with term, grade, level, instructor, textbook and topics; research
projects; talks; publications and preprints; and referee contact details. This is an organizational
recommendation, not an additional application requirement. The individual dossiers specify which parts each
school actually requests.
Maintain separate drafts for academic preparation and research fit, personal/background experiences, and a
proposed research project. Those documents are not interchangeable. A CV slot does not authorize an extra
paper upload, and a portal that accepts a link does not necessarily accept a manuscript. Use the exact linked
prompt and current portal limit when preparing each final version.
Record two dates for every reference: when you must initiate the request and when the referee must finish. A
saved referee name, a sent invitation, an applicant submission and a completed letter are four distinct events.
Check the institution's invitation rule before entering contacts. Scholarship references may use a separate
form or assessment even when the same professor writes both.
April 15 is a funding-response rule with a 2027 change
The Council of Graduate Schools requires institutions to re-sign its resolution for programs starting in Fall 2027;
pre-April-2026 signatory lists alone do not establish current participation. The resolution covers full tuition
support, fellowships, traineeships and assistantships. It does not make every admission offer, unfunded
master's offer or non-US offer expire on April 15. Wisconsin explicitly confirms that it re-signed the revised
resolution.
The current FAQ permits intermediate check-in deadlines. Respond to them and request more time if needed;
ignoring one can cost an offer. At participating programs, the protected deadline is April 15 at 11:59 p.m. in the
offering school's time zone. After April 15, withdrawal from an accepted funding offer must be communicated
in writing; a formal release is not required. Check the actual offer and current institutional participation.
CGS: current April 15 Resolution and Fall 2027 re-signing requirement
CGS: revised FAQ, updated 29 July 2026
Wisconsin: explicit confirmation of re-signing

GRE reporting dates are separate from application dates
ETS lists the 2026-27 Subject Test windows as September 14-27, 2026; October 19-November 1, 2026; and
April 19-May 2, 2027. Their score-release dates are October 5, November 9 and May 10, respectively. Thus the
next scheduled subject-test window after this report date is in spring 2027; it is too late for a December or
January deadline unless that program explicitly permits later scores.
ETS says online additional Subject Test score-report orders take approximately five business days to process;
institutional matching may take additional time. General Test scores normally become available eight to ten
days after testing and remain reportable for five years. These are ETS processing rules, not a university grace
period. Use each school's receipt deadline and policy on self-reported scores, official reports and later updates.
ETS: Subject Test administration and reporting schedule
ETS: sending Subject Test scores
ETS: General Test scoring and reporting
English admission waivers and teaching eligibility are different
A UChicago degree can satisfy many schools' admission-language rules, but the details differ: a completed
degree versus a degree in progress; residence in an English-speaking country; a minimum number of graded
credits or years; a recent-degree window; and an automatic exemption versus a requested waiver. Maryland
Mathematics and Carnegie Mellon require particular care, and Copenhagen expressly rejects a
university-degree-only exemption. See each detailed English field.
An admission waiver does not necessarily waive the spoken-English assessment for a teaching assistantship.
Conversely, a teaching condition should not be mistaken for an admission test requirement. Where university
and mathematics instructions conflict, both are recorded and the unresolved question is explicit.
Read funding amounts on the same basis
For each offer, distinguish cash stipend or gross salary from tuition remission, health coverage and mandatory
fees. Keep the payment period visible: nine academic months, ten months, twelve months, a semester, or a
scholarship year. Multiplying a monthly rate by twelve does not establish summer funding. A university
minimum or collective-agreement scale is not itself a department's offer.
For European routes, admission to a master's degree, a tuition scholarship, a living-cost award and a salaried
doctoral vacancy may have separate applications. A four-year US bachelor's does not automatically replace the
master's-level preparation required by every doctoral program. Current and historical amounts are labeled
separately throughout this report.
US national fellowships that F-1 status does not make available
The FY 2027 NSF Graduate Research Fellowship requires US citizenship, US-national status or permanent
residence; foreign students on student visas are ineligible. The DOE Computational Science Graduate
Fellowship likewise excludes an F-1 applicant who lacks US citizenship or lawful permanent residence. NDSEG
is narrower: it requires US citizenship or US-national status and excludes permanent residents. These are
separate from university assistantships and institutional fellowships available to international students.
NSF: FY 2027 GRFP solicitation, citizenship eligibility
DOE CSGF: Fall 2027 application FAQ, explicit F-1 question
NDSEG: current citizenship and degree-timing eligibility

F-1 transfer belongs after admission, with its own timetable
Applying to graduate school does not itself transfer your SEVIS record. After choosing a US program, coordinate
the release date, new I-20, program start and any travel or work plans with UChicago's international office and
the admitting institution. University international-office guidance describes the transfer as requiring admission
to the new institution, maintenance of valid status, and a new program beginning at the next available term
within the applicable five-month limit. The current school's graduation/grace-period dates matter. This report
has not calculated your individual immigration timetable.
A move to Canada, Europe or Asia requires that destination's admission and immigration process; current US
F-1 status is not destination-country residence or scholarship eligibility. School-specific deposits, financial
evidence and final-degree deadlines are retained where published.
University of Illinois Chicago international office: F-1 transfer-out timing (general explanatory guidance; not UChicago's own
request form)

Deadlines by school
Full application and funding policies are retained here. Follow the school link for reference, test-score, supporting-document and
offer-acceptance deadlines. Status labels distinguish explicit 2027 dates from standing or prior-cycle schedules.
Arizona State University
Academic application; Funding consideration [Conflict]
School admits for fall only: December 10 for full TA/RA consideration, with rolling admission until July 1. Dates
are standing, not explicitly labeled Fall 2027; time zone unpublished. The central degree page labels July 1
under Summer, which conflicts with the school’s fall-only wording. Use December 10 for funded consideration
and confirm final-term labeling. [s1] [s2]
Auburn University
Academic application [Conflict]
Department accepts applications year-round, prefers fall for GTA positions, and publishes no exact
mathematics complete-file date. Central international rules say at least 90 days before classes, while
international page says three months. Fall 2027 classes begin August 16: calendar arithmetic yields May 18 for
90 days, May 16 for three months. Use May 16 at latest pending confirmation; these are derived administrative
limits, NOT funding priority dates. All relevant materials and applicable official scores must arrive. [s1] [s2] [s3]
[s10]
Funding consideration [Unresolved]
No exact 2027 GTA date is published; contact GPO Yanzhao Cao (yzc0009@auburn.edu) early. PGRF
nomination deadlines are set internally by college, described generally as early spring. Do not rely on the May
administrative deadline for funding. [s1] [s8] [s9]

[s5]

application and transcript first, then request exemption after allowing up to 72 hours. [s2] [s4] [s5] [s7]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
2027-28 mathematics cash offer not published. Department describes a nine-month fellowship stipend plus
tuition exemption. University 2026-27 benchmarks: no appointment $37,506 nine-month + $6,753 summer =
$44,259; with appointment $38,256 + $6,753 = $45,009. Twelve-month benchmarks $50,008/$51,008
respectively. These are institutional benchmarks, not a confirmed 2027 math award. Central PhD package
includes tuition and health; department notes some student activity/transcript fees may remain. [s3] [s12] [s6]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Five-year fellowship for all admitted mathematics PhD students, conditional on satisfactory progress. Verify
exact summer coverage and later-year teaching duties in offer. [s3]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International PhD admits eligible for the same tuition/health/living support; citizenship does not exclude
institutional funding. [s6] [s14]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Good academic standing/progress required. Department describes tuition exemption, stipend and eligibility for

Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No additional institutional funding application required. [s6] [s14]
Other funding routes [Conflict]

two full stipends. [s3] [s13] [s12]

US $125 for the 2027 application, nonrefundable; credit card (Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover). File incomplete

After submitting application, request through Applicant Status with supporting hardship documents; do not pay
while pending. Financial-need wording has no stated citizenship exclusion. Usually 5-7 business days;
maximum two lifetime GSAS waivers. Research-pathway/event and named agency sponsorship routes also
exist. If denied, pay before completion. No distinct published request cutoff found. [s9]

Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
2026-27 published rates, not a 2027-28 offer: Ithaca assistantship USD 36,684/9 months plus USD
12,228/13-week summer = USD 48,912/12 months. University Fellowship USD 36,684 academic plus USD

summer, but which fellowship/assistantship combination applies is in offer. Do not use Cornell Tech’s separate
rate. [s10] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
All admitted Mathematics PhDs receive five years including summers, conditional on satisfactory
progress/work. First-year fellowship is an aim, not a universal promise. Sixth-year support may be requested
before end of ninth semester with advisor copied, reason and completion date; not guaranteed. [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department states all admitted Math PhDs receive support, without a citizenship exception; inference:
international admits included. Individual external fellowships may restrict citizenship. [s9]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress and assigned duties. TA work averages at most 15 hours weekly; at least one summer TA
assignment, usually second/third year. At least 75% of TA assignments are recitation sections. External support
replaces internal support with possible supplement, not automatic double stipend; notify graduate field
coordinator. [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No additional reference/essay or separate application established for ordinary Mathematics recruitment
fellowships; department selects candidates during admission. Outside scholarships can impose distinct
questions, references and deadlines. [s9]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Recruitment fellowships; external fellowships; Hutchinson teaching-relief award after A exam; Torng summer
award; Battig/York awards after A exam; emergency assistance. Eligibility/deadlines vary and are not all
admission scholarships. [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 105 nonrefundable; credit/debit online at submission. Paying or obtaining waiver is final step and locks
application. [s3]

Complete application then request waiver on payment page at least three business days before program
deadline (10 December 2026 is calculated planning cutoff). Hardship explanation addresses
finances/home-country conditions. Hardship waiver available for fully funded doctoral/research-master’s
applicants or FAFSA-eligible applicants; Math PhD fits first route regardless of F-1 status, but approval not
guaranteed. Do not pay before decision. [s3]

actual coursework. [s1] [s6]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Current 2026-27 contractual minimum USD 52,000 annually for a full fiscal-year appointment (12-month
annual basis), with proration for shorter/partial appointments; not a confirmed Fall 2027 offer. Math guarantees
full tuition and benefits with support. Owen supplement is USD 6,000/year for three years for selected
exceptional applicants. Central 2026-27 cost page says resident full-time PhD health insurance is covered;
tuition/insurance value is not extra cash. The agreement’s initial term ends June 30, 2027, with conditional
automatic renewal, so 2027-28 rate must be rechecked. [s1] [s8] [s9] [s18]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Five years of support conditional on satisfactory progress; sixth-year support generally possible for students on
track who would benefit, but not an unconditional sixth-year guarantee. First year is TA-free and an additional
dissertation-stage semester is teaching-free. VTSI, for eligible selected applicants, offers up to six years. [s2]
[s17]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Mathematics says all admitted PhD students receive support and explicitly admits international students.
Contract includes international employees and immigration-related assistance. Need-based relocation
maximum is USD 2,500 for international entrants versus USD 2,000 domestic; award requires admission,
financial need and eventual matriculation. Funding-specific external citizenship restrictions still need checking.
[s1] [s2] [s8] [s9] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Maintain full-time resident enrollment, satisfactory academic progress and assigned employment duties. TA
duties are normally required after year one; contract average work cap is 20 hours/week, distinct from
academic study. Teaching seminar is normally first year; written algebra/analysis exams by start of year two,
oral research exam by April 10 of year three. Sixth year is conditional. Outside earnings and appointments
remain subject to institutional/funder and immigration rules. [s2] [s9] [s14]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Regular PhD support is automatic with admission; no extra Owen application listed. VTSI needs its supplement
and early complete file; eligible applicants receive a fee waiver through the application. Relocation application
link is emailed within 48 hours of an admission offer, with one request even for multiple admitted programs,
and payment depends on enrollment. Other supplemental nomination procedures are not public. [s1] [s10] [s11]

Owen supplement; summer teaching for extra income; university-wide fellowships. Beverly Wendland

requires Posse alumni status, neither established here. VTSI requires eligible institutional attendance. Contract

assistance; external awards paid through JHU below the minimum are topped up during guaranteed funding.

enrollment. University normally expects at least 3.0 in junior/senior undergraduate work. Math admits
internationally and only for fall; the ordinary Math/Applied Math MS is not a separate entry route. F-1 status is
not academic disqualification; new immigration documentation follows admission. [s1] [s2] [s7] [s8]

upload the required documents and pay or arrange departmental payment. No prior supervisor agreement is
published. Check the English waiver before omitting a test. [s1] [s5] [s13]

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
If not waived, TOEFL taken after January 21, 2026: total4.5, reading/speaking≥4, listening/writing≥4.5; older
TOEFL80 with R/L/S≥19,W≥22. IELTS6.5 with every band≥6. Central PTE53(R/L/S≥51,W≥59) and DET110 also

do not infer Math accepts provisional English admission. [s1] [s6] [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed regular US four-year bachelor's with most credits earned in the US qualifies for automatic
admissions waiver (not an online/experiential/overseas-branch degree). UChicago meets the institutional
setting; confirm handling while the BA is still in progress. A nonautomatic waiver is submitted by the
department. Admission waiver does NOT waive spoken-English TA certification: TOEFL speaking27/5.5, IELTS
speaking8, MSU Speaking Test50, or specified language-course plus oral-test route. [s6] [s9]

five-year validity. No published Fall 2027 exception found. [s1] [s2]

Strongly recommended, not formally required. FAQ warns admission without it is very rare and asks for other
strong mathematical evidence, such as advanced courses or research examples. Do not mistake optional for
indifferent. Five-year validity. [s1] [s2]

Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s degree completed by enrollment permits direct PhD application; full-time study only. Minimum
background: three calculus semesters including advanced calculus or linear algebra; actual preparation is
normally greater. UChicago bachelor’s and international status are compatible with application; GSAS explicitly
considers applicants irrespective of citizenship. [s1] [s7]

Select Mathematics PhD in GSAS (not Tandon); only one GSAS application per term. Gather transcripts, three
references and subject GRE or short impossibility explanation. Resolve conflicting January dates with
admissions@math.nyu.edu before submission. [s1] [s2] [s6]

metadata verified for Pirutka, Tosatti, Tschinkel, but Bogomolov/Cappell official pages are stale. Ask about
active supervision and availability. [s12] [s13]

considered. Minimum preparation advanced calculus, linear algebra and differential equations; typical
admitted preparation includes two semesters each of real analysis and senior algebra plus another advanced
course. International F1 applicants are eligible. [s2] [s3]

academic records, and arrange required Math GRE or obtain an approved waiver. No departmental pre-review
is available. Resolve English eligibility; departmental submission deadlines override portal dates. [s1] [s2]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor’s completed by matriculation is eligible in degree type; academic eligibility additionally
requires 3.0 in junior/senior and post-baccalaureate work, 3.5 upper-division math GPA, and at least 12
quarter/8 semester substantial upper-division math courses. Exceptions only for demonstrated exceptional
quantitative ability. International applicants need comparable record. PhD admission only; MA/MAT suspended.

Before submission [Standing rule]
Select pure or applied area and field in application; choose only one UCLA major. Prepare transcripts, required
math-course list, SOP, personal statement, three letters, Math GRE and fee/waiver evidence. Check whether
department still wants original transcripts at application. [s1] [s2] [s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Select research field; SOP may identify mentors. No supervisor agreement listed as a precondition. Reach out
only with specific fit questions and confirm 2027 capacity. [s2] [s5]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use UCLA graduate application; one major. Send referee invitations after entry, track receipt and reminders;
submit on time despite pending letters. Updates go directly to department. Public research did not create an
application. [s4] [s5] [s7]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No exact annual mathematics stipend published on reviewed admissions, financial-support or handbook pages;
amounts vary annually. Guarantee normally includes living income, full registration fees, health insurance and
nonresident tuition. Obtain 2027-28 gross cash, appointment months and summer amount from offer.

UCLA Group 2, salary point 1, 50% TA appointment USD 4,323/month effective October 1, 2026 and USD
4,432/month effective October 1, 2027. These are contractual monthly appointment rates, not a promised
12-month Mathematics package; multiply only by actual paid months in the offer. [s2] [s3] [s10] [ucwages27]

Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible in principle with a mathematics/related bachelor's completed before enrollment and undergraduate
GPA at least 3.0. International status is allowed. For applicants without a master's, central instructions
recommend selecting the combined PhD/MA where available; this differs from the UCSB-undergraduate-only
five-year combined program. [s3] [s4] [s5]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics PhD/MA or confirm the appropriate objective with math-gradinfo@math.ucsb.edu. Prepare
the required Math GRE, three referees, two statements, CV and course descriptions/textbooks. Only one UCSB
application per year is allowed. No prior supervisor agreement is listed. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No advance adviser agreement stated. Direct requirements/deadline questions to
math-gradinfo@math.ucsb.edu. Contact research faculty to ask about 2027 capacity; current affiliation does
not establish openings. Zhao's official advice expects prospective students in his area to learn
schemes/sheaves/cohomology by the end of their second PhD year. [s1] [s39]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Slate application and Applicant Portal are linked by Graduate Division. Final submission is irreversible; content
cannot generally be changed afterward, although checklist items/references have their own controls. Upload
only required supporting documents. Use the live Requirements & Deadlines screen to resolve older
page/interface language. [s4] [s6]

minimum at 50% is $24,200 for nine months ($2,688.89 monthly), or $32,266.68 over twelve months;
appointment duration matters. These carry forward rates effective August 16, 2025 while successor contract
negotiations continue. Illinois Distinguished Fellowship is indexed at $75,000 total; other official departments
describe $25,000 annually for three years, a standing cross-program description rather than a verified 2027
Math award. Tuition waiver is separate; ordinary summer income is not guaranteed. [u6] [u9] [u10] [u14] [u25]
[u26]
Years of support [Standing rule]
For entrants with a bachelor's, ordinary support may be renewed for six years, subject to satisfactory progress
and assigned duties. Entrants with a two-year master's generally receive five years. Summer funding is
separate unless expressly included in the offer. [u6]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Ordinary assistantships and associated tuition waivers are available to international students, subject to work
authorization and TA English qualification. GAANN opportunities advertised for US applicants do not establish
F1 eligibility. Dean's Doctoral Fellowship eligibility was not fully accessible; do not assume F1 eligibility.
Financial certification for immigration follows an accepted offer, not the academic application. [u1] [u3] [u6] [u13]
[u17]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
A typical 50% TA entails about 20 hours/week: first-year assignments may include two two-hour discussion
sections, coordination, tutoring and grading. Full tuition waiver applies regardless of residency, with only
partial fee waiver; current health subsidy and remaining fees must be confirmed. Progress and
teaching-language qualification govern renewal. Department's approximately $1,700 immigration-budget gap
is an undated example; current I-20 costs and the actual award govern. [u1] [u6] [u15]
Extra funding application [2027 confirmed]
Ordinary support considered with admission. Department-nominated Illinois Distinguished and Dean's Doctoral
competitions: round 1 nomination deadline January 7, 2027, decisions February 12; round 2 February 18,
decisions March 30. These are departmental nomination dates, not substitutes for the December 1 Math
application deadline. Math's internal nomination cutoff and supplementary materials remain unverified; no
public time zone found. [u1] [u6] [u11]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Conditional summer teaching/research generally listed at $2,000-$6,000 for one to three months; adviser
grants, departmental awards, external/home-country fellowships and the campus assistantship clearinghouse
may help. Morisato Summer 2026 award offered $4,500 for six weeks to current Illinois Mathematics Lab team
leaders with at least two terms' involvement; this is not guaranteed entry funding. Older Equity Doctoral
Fellowship wording has been superseded by current Dean's Doctoral terminology. [u6] [u11] [u13] [u17] [u24]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$90 nonrefundable application fee, paid electronically before the application is processed/submitted. Budget
the current central fee and confirm portal amount. [u2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
International applicants ordinarily cannot receive an application-fee waiver except under an approved
exchange agreement. A US undergraduate degree alone does not make an F1 applicant domestic. Domestic
qualifying-program waivers are distinct. FreeApp requests for Spring/Summer/Fall 2027 are accepted only
before June 30, 2027 and must precede application submission; that later program date does not extend
Math's December 1 deadline and does not establish this applicant's eligibility. [u2]

mathematics master’s. The terminal MS is a separate route. [s1] [s5]

window. [s1] [s3]

Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD admission with a bachelor's is permitted; about two-thirds of admits have bachelor's degrees. GPA
below 3.0 is not considered (page also says above 3.0). Require two terms each of advanced analysis and
advanced algebra; for quarter institutions three terms are encouraged. Courses may be in progress.
International applicants are eligible. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics PhD in USC's Liaison application. Mathematics and Applied Mathematics are reviewed
together; applying to both has no advantage. Arrange official-issued transcripts and three academic referees
early. Request any fee waiver before submission. Establish English exemption or submit official scores. [s1] [s2]

English requirement [Conflict]
Math lists TOEFL 100, IELTS 7 or PTE 68. Central policy for Spring 2027 onward accepts TOEFL, IELTS, PTE and
Cambridge C1 Advanced; scores valid two years at submission. Its PhD ISE-exemption thresholds are old TOEFL
100/20 each, new TOEFL 5/4 each, IELTS 7/6 each, PTE 68/53 each, Cambridge 185/169 each; distinguish
placement thresholds from departmental admission rules. Official scores required; ETS 4852. Confirm the Math
policy for the new TOEFL scale/Cambridge. [s1] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Central graduate policy exempts a holder of a US bachelor's degree, including permitted transferred credits.
Completed UChicago degree fits. A still-pending bachelor's is not explicitly covered by 'hold': obtain
confirmation. A bachelor's exemption does not itself exempt the separate ITA interview. ITA test may be
waived for TOEFL speaking/listening 6/5.5 (old 29/25) or IELTS 8.5/7, but the department may still require it.

Not considered. [s1]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Records from every postsecondary institution. USC requires official-issued records; a student-portal printout is
unacceptable. Central transcript instructions allow a scan of an official-issued record, mail or secure electronic
delivery. The application guide also describes official records sent directly; safest is official-issued upload plus
direct delivery. Electronic transcripts go to etrans@usc.edu after submission and receipt of the ten-digit USC
ID. Include original-language records and word-for-word English translations where applicable; no WES
substitute. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate Math course-list requirement identified in the departmental list. Advanced algebra and analysis
prerequisites must be visible in records; inspect the live program questions. [s1]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No mandatory course-description upload established. Prepare descriptions if equivalence of advanced
analysis/algebra is unclear. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required. Ideally all are higher-education mathematics faculty who taught the applicant for at least a
semester within the last three years; at least one should have supervised mathematical research. The page
excludes unsuitable sources such as high-school teachers, TAs, coaches and coworkers; nontraditional paths
should meet the spirit of these criteria. [s1]

Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Accredited US bachelor’s degree or equivalent, adequate mathematical preparation and normally GPA at least
3.0 in upper-division and any graduate work. Below-minimum applicants may apply with an explanatory letter.
UChicago math bachelor is an eligible degree route if completed in time; GPA/history remain unverified. Only
fall PhD admission; mathematics master’s is actuarial only. [s4] [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Apply early enough for multi-step processing: initial form takes 2-3 business days to load; then pay fee and
complete MyStatus documents. Transcript verification takes another 2-3 business days. Use assigned UT EID,
never create a duplicate. Choose primary interest ANG for algebra/number theory/geometry, optional
secondary and up to three specific areas; choices guide reviewers but do not bind your eventual specialty. [s2]

qualifying master's study/research record; not automatically eligible. [s1]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible in principle for the thesis MSc after a four-year UChicago mathematics bachelor’s, subject to a 3.0/4.0
GPA over the final two years and academic fit. The published PhD requirement is a relevant master’s; a
bachelor’s-only direct-PhD route was not established. International applicants are accepted. F-1 status is not
Canadian study authorization. A supervisor is needed by commencement, not necessarily before applying. [s1]

Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose the funded thesis MSc rather than the unfunded course MSc. Contact possible supervisors with CV and
transcript; list names on the application. Obtain three referees’ consent, create an eID, complete/pay the
application, then use Student Centre for documents. Request an English exemption decision if relying on
UChicago. Apply separately for GAC once an applicant UCID is available. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s8] [s11]

Science’s higher threshold applies: TOEFL taken before January 21, 2026: 97 with every section 23; tests

confirmation, especially if the degree is still in progress at application. F-1 status itself gives no exemption. [s8]

Pay attention to
• Scholarships require separate actions and earlier deadlines than ordinary admission.

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago mathematics bachelor can apply to the MSc through individual foreign-degree assessment; it is not
direct Flemish-degree admission. Programme describes at least 90 ECTS of broad mathematics as ideal
preparation. PhD ordinarily requires a relevant Flemish master or equivalent foreign qualification with
distinction (or distinguished research achievements), or a distinguished predoctoral exam. A BA alone is not
established as equivalent; MSc-first is the ordinary route. F-1 status does not determine Belgian
visa/fee/nationality rules. [s1] [s2] [s16]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: check the year-specific requirements, application-window and tuition selectors; create the university
application, upload core and programme documents and pay €120. Science@Leuven: first submit the degree
application, then upload its confirmation email in the separate scholarship registration; do not wait for
academic acceptance. Joint KU Leuven/Master Mind: add the candidacy annexe AND complete scholarship
registration. PhD: first secure a supervisor or funded vacancy; only that supervisor can initiate the degree
application and send its unique link. [s5] [s7] [s11] [s16]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc admission does not require prior supervisor agreement. Doctoral admission expressly requires a KU
Leuven supervisor to initiate the process; contact faculty with research fit or apply to a financed vacancy.
Cluckers and Mohammadi are part-time in the algebra roster, so ask about local availability. Denef/Coppens
are emeriti and several familiar names (including Botong Wang/Lei Wu) are former members, not current
ordinary advisers. [s16] [s24]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Create application → documents/fee → submit and receive confirmation → scholarship registration where
relevant → track assessment → final degree verification before enrolment. Missing mandatory documents block
submission. A portal still accepting submissions does not mean an official deadline was extended. PhD must
use the supervisor-generated unique application link. [s3] [s5] [s16] [s18]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Scholarship dates/forms explicitly 2027-28; Mathematics academic requirements currently shown in 2026-27
guide, with standing rules. Dynamic academic deadline/tuition need applicant-specific confirmation. Master
Mind funding explicitly preliminary untilJanuary 2027; older Science microsite says 2026 closed, while
central2027call is open. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s7] [s11]

Academic application [Unresolved]
The official programme directs applicants to a dynamic selector by academic year, nationality and programme;
the specific Mathematics 2027 result was not retrievable from public text. Do not substitute the March/June
dates of other faculties. The general absolute registration backstop is 22 September 2027, not a safe

deadline; vacancy/supervisor controls. [s2] [s5] [s6] [s16]

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc Mathematics: TOEFL old scale 94, reading19/listening18/speaking19/writing21; new scale4.5,
reading4/listening4/speaking3.5/writing4.5. IELTS Academic7.0, reading6.5 and other sections6.0. Cambridge
C1/C2 185, reading176 and other sections169. General accepted formats include TOEFL Home/Paper and IELTS
Online; not TOEFL MyBest, IELTS One Skill Retake or Duolingo. PhD uses separate B2 thresholds: IELTS6.5/no
section below6; old TOEFL79 with reading18/writing23; since July 2026 new TOEFL4 with
listening/reading/speaking4, writing4.5. [s1] [s17] [s19]

Completed wholly English-taught US university degrees qualify for MSc exemption; UChicago BA meets the
stated location/language route once awarded. Science scholarship accepts degree/transcripts confirming the
whole course was in English; joint scholarships also explicitly exempt completed English US programmes.

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload higher-education diploma(s) and official transcripts (interim official transcripts if still studying),
translations if outside English/Dutch/French/German, passport identity page, English evidence/exemption, CV,
motivation and fee evidence. Secondary-school documents are not needed for MSc. Grading
explanation/course descriptions are programme additions with the exemption below. Final degree verification
may use secure institution records, direct registrar email or original degree and final transcript in person;
institution email must identify student/application and link the registrar’s publicly listed address. [s1] [s3] [s18]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Science@Leuven explicitly asks for all credited course titles, credits/ECTS and grades, with an explanation of
the grade scale. Do not invent ECTS conversions: supply institutional workload evidence where US quarter
credits differ. Ordinary MSc transcript provides course history. [s7] [s8]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc: relevant courses need English descriptions of objectives, topics, workload and materials; online
syllabus text may be copied. Applicants from a Science exchange partner or a latest THE/QS global top-200
university are exempt from course/grading descriptions. UChicago is within the QS top200, so the ordinary
exemption appears applicable. HOWEVER Science@Leuven independently asks about half to one page of
relevant-course descriptions (content/textbooks/credits); its page does not grant the top200 exemption.
Prepare these for scholarship review. [s1] [s7] [s8] [s22]

Number and type [Standing rule]

from internationally recognised professors. Generic recommendation templates are not evidence that all MSc
applicants need letters. PhD letters depend on vacancy/funding. [s1] [s3] [s7]

before submission or sent directly using the published alternative; request delivery before the complete-file
deadline. [s8]

The applicant receives confirmation of degree submission and separately of Science scholarship registration.

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Science@Leuven 2027: €12,000/year, plus non-EEA partial tuition reduction; residual 2027 tuition undecided
(2026-27 was €3,252.72). Inspiring 2027: ONE award, €13,200/year and full tuition waiver except about€140
annual administration. Master Mind 2027 is PROVISIONAL: KU Leuven says€10,750 covering programme
length, tuition around€1,200/year; annual interpretation is not confirmed. Prior government 2026 terms
were€10,225/year with near-full waiver and explicitly under2027review. No universal MSc stipend. PhD
scholarship net amount is individually calculated and equals an assistant’s net pay; salaried researchers use
scale43. No mathematically specific 2027 annual offer verified. [s7] [s11] [s12] [s15] [s20] [s21]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Science initially one year, renewable for a second consecutive year: standing continuation rule requires
enrolment in at least60 credits, passing all enrolled credits and excellent grades. Inspiring covers up to two
years for 120ECTS. Master Mind describes one or two years by programme length but its provisional amount
wording needs clarification. Doctoral employment/fellowship duration follows the vacancy; no automatic
MSc-to-PhD funding commitment. [s7] [s10] [s11] [s12] [s16]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Science: all nationalities except Belgian; non-Belgian bachelor, no previous KU Leuven study/work, no prior
MSc/PhD, ambassador commitment. Joint Master Mind/Inspiring: all nationalities, prior degree outside Flanders;
existing Flemish enrolment usually disqualifies except specified preparatory study/exchange exceptions.
Nationality-specific ASEAN/Africa/Central-SouthAmerica awards share the joint application; eligibility cannot be
determined from F-1 alone. [s7] [s11] [s12]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Science needs excellent bachelor results comparable to distinction and is competitive; candidates ranked,
around8 interviewed, decisions beginningMay 2027. Joint schemes judge academic performance, awards,
motivation, experience, leadership and commitment. Master Mind cannot combine with other KU
Leuven/Belgian-government/European-Commission awards; Inspiring disallows other full awards from those
sources. Funding is not guaranteed by admission. [s7] [s11] [s12]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Two independent routes: January 15 joint scholarship annexe plus registration; February 15 Science
scholarship registration after degree submission. Science registration must include PDF proof of
degree-application submission; receipt email completes registration. Eligible nationality-based Science fee
reduction may require a third form byMarch1. Do not confuse a tuition reduction with an application-fee
waiver. [s7] [s11] [s14] [s23]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Science nationality fee waiver: procedure1 automatically covers listed least-developed/low-income citizenships
(32 African and10 Asian countries on source); procedure2 is application-based for lower-middle-income
countries/territories, due1 March 2027 with degree-submission proof. All qualifying admitted applicants receive
it;2027 residual fee undecided. FWO/project PhD vacancies are separate future routes; no live matching 2027
doctoral stipend verified. Consult the official calculator for ordinary tuition by nationality/programme/year; its
numerical Mathematics result was not retrievable. [s14] [s2] [s16]
Application fee [Standing rule]
€120 nonrefundable PER degree application; pay card through portal or bank transfer plus detailed proof.
(Pre)doctoral applications are exempt. This is separate from tuition and from the approximately€140
administration charge associated with Inspiring scholarship. [s4]

category. A subsequent Leiden PhD normally requires a master’s degree and a supervisor/job or separately
arranged funded route; this is not an ordinary US-style BA-to-PhD cohort. [admit] [docs] [phd] [phdapply]

section. PhD: approach the institute or apply to an advertised vacancy before Graduate School registration.

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Two distinct routes. PhD: any citizenship; the qualifying degree must permit doctoral entry in its home system,
normally a master's or equivalent degree of at least four years, subject to the committee's equivalence
assessment. Thus a four-year UChicago BA is potentially admissible, not automatically approved: obtain a
written eligibility ruling. Prior call required the qualifying degree within the preceding five years or by 31
October 2026, and barred holders of an Italian PhD or previous Italian doctoral scholarships. Ordinary II level:
bachelor's/equivalent for concurrent Pisa MSc; prior call required first qualifying degree on/after 1 November
2024 or by 31 December 2026, and restrictions on previous master's enrollment in the relevant Italian classes
or foreign equivalent. An undergraduate taking graduate classes is not necessarily a prior master's enrollee;
clarify if applicable. Adequate Italian is required for ordinary admission. F-1 status is not Italian study
authorization. [s2] [s3] [s6]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
M1 is the usual bachelor’s-to-master’s route: a mathematics degree and adequate preparation are assessed. A
four-year UChicago BA does not automatically count as French M1; direct M2 requires individual M1
equivalence. ED 386 normally requires a research master’s/equivalent, an HDR-qualified supervisor, an agreed
project and institutional funding; personal self-funding is excluded. F-1 status establishes US residence/status,
not French admission or nationality eligibility. [s1] [s2] [s14]
Before submission [Standing rule]
For non-EU citizenship while resident in the US, the mathematics page directs applicants through Campus
France/Études en France. EU/EEA citizenship changes the route to MonMaster. Check the exact programme’s
portal listing and any additional institutional procedure. PGSM is an independent scholarship application;
choose one to three eligible master’s routes and also apply for admission. A Campus France review and
interview follow initial submission. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s9]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
For M1/M2, use programme coordinators to assess level equivalence and course preparation; an agreed thesis
supervisor is not a published master’s prerequisite. For PhD, an HDR supervisor in an ED 386 partner
laboratory and agreed research project are prerequisites. IMJ-PRG spans Sorbonne, Paris Cité and CNRS:
affiliation alone does not mean everyone is a Sorbonne professor. [s14] [s20]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
eCandidat: activate account within five days, upload/merge supporting records and submit explicitly; statuses
distinguish received from complete. A displayed return deadline blocks later uploads. PGSM sends a
confirmation email and supports returning to complete the dossier. Keep scholarship and academic
applications separate. [s12] [s9]

obtained in China/India/Vietnam; a UChicago-earned degree does not meet that stated trigger merely because
of citizenship. If selected for stage2, attend a20-30 minute English interview, normally July/August for winter

Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
MSc: no universal stipend. SCIENCE government scholarship covers full tuition and22 months of living costs;
monthly cash amount is not published. Government study portal lists mathematics tuition EUR8700/semester,
EUR17400/year, without a 2027-specific guarantee. Integrated PhD before master: up to48 grant portions at
DKK7426 each (2026 rate), plus salary for 150 work hours/year; portions are not a stated48-month payment
schedule. Later salaried phase and regular PhD follow collective agreement; math call does not quote annual
salary. A separate UCPH 2026 PhD ad quotes DKK31800/month plus18.07% employer pension, indicative only,
not a math 2027 guarantee. [s6] [s7] [s8] [s44]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc scholarship living component22 months; ordinary degree two years. Integrated PhD up to five full-time
years including MSc, adjusted for prior MSc study; master is completed two years before PhD completion,
followed by two salaried years. Regular post-master PhD is three years. Travel support is included in
departmental stipends, amount unspecified. [s6] [s8] [s12] [s16]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
MSc government scholarship is for non-EU/EEA candidates required to pay tuition and eligible for a Danish
study permit, excluding those entitled to Danish SU. International applicants can compete for PhD
employment/integrated stipends; citizenship is not an advertised exclusion. US F-1 does not replace Danish
permission. [s6] [s8]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
SCIENCE scholarship selection is academic only: first-priority programme and GPA above90% of
maximum;2025 winners had at least98%, not a 2027 guaranteed cutoff. Taxes may apply. PhD requires funded
salary/living costs, tuition and research expenses; central rules prohibit self-paying PhDs from May 2025.
Annual PhD tuition is a funding-budget item, not automatically an additional personal bill. [s6] [s13] [s15]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate government-scholarship application. PhD call is a competitive funded position followed by formal
academic enrollment; integrated candidates must fulfill MSc enrollment conditions. External-funded applicants
are still encouraged to enter the departmental selection process and disclose support. [s6] [s10] [s11] [s12]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
SCIENCE second-year merit scholarships may be awarded after completing60 ECTS by September 1;2025
selection used at least11 on the Danish scale and at most three awards per nationality. Decisions come early
September, with third-semester tuition refunded for recipients. These retrospective criteria are not a promised
2027 entrance award. External doctoral funding must cover all required costs; no self-paying arrangement. [s6]

MSc non-EU application fee DKK1120 (approximately EUR150), once per round for up to three programmes;

the standing schedule. No application charge was found for the employment-based PhD call. [s5] [s8]

should be confirmed in offer. [s1] [s4]

Austria · MSc Mathematics; later doctorate and separately advertised VSM employment
European research-fit addition. VSM is joint with TU Wien; the ordinary MSc described here is University of Vienna.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc application requires an already completed bachelor; predicted graduation is insufficient.
• Winter 2027-28 dates remain unpublished.
• No guaranteed MSc living stipend.
• VSM is a doctoral network with separate project/job applications; its posts are not a direct-bachelor US-style
PhD round.
• Krattenthaler is retired; Hauser and Schwermer are also retired/emeritus in the current roster.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: UChicago mathematics bachelor is assessed individually, with no advance equivalence ruling. Subject
gaps may require up to30 ECTS of supplementary exams within two semesters; larger gaps preclude
admission. Crucially, the degree must already be fully completed when applying to this programme without
selection procedure: future-completion letters and provisional transcripts are not accepted. Doctorate normally
requires a relevant master or qualification at the same level, plus a supervisor; no assured direct route from
the UChicago bachelor was established. [s1] [s4] [s7] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Wait until the bachelor is completed, obtain final records or an official completion confirmation, prepare English
evidence, create a u:account and apply through u:space. US-issued educational documents need no diplomatic
legalisation; English records need no translation. Later doctorate: obtain supervision confirmation and project
agreement in principle before academic application; apply separately to funded jobs. [s2] [s4] [s6] [s9] [s10]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc admission does not require a supervisor; the curriculum recommends contacting an adviser in the first
semester for course planning. Later doctoral admission does require a qualified supervisor’s written
confirmation. Current research-fit faculty below do not imply an open 2027 position. [s7] [s9] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Create/activate u:account, register personal data and ID in u:space, upload complete records, review and click
Submit application; only submitted status initiates review. Admission letter arrives by email and in Personal
Matters/My Documents. Job5204 uses the university job portal, with referee emails sent separately. [s2] [s12]

Pay attention to
• Bachelor’s-only direct PhD eligibility requires an equivalence decision; four US undergraduate years do not
themselves equal an integrated UK master’s.
• University scholarship letters technically have a later deadline, but reviewers may start before that grace
period ends.
• Department funding lasts four years; some university scholarships last only three and a half.
• Do not infer an available 2027 MASt intake from old contact-page labels.
• David Loeffler and Sarah Zerbes have honorary/visiting listings; John Cremona and David Mond are emeriti.
They are not treated here as ordinary available supervisors. Relevant shortlist is broad but does not certify
every faculty member’s 2027 capacity.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
MSc: first-class-equivalent mathematics or mathematically intensive science bachelor’s. PhD: first-class
integrated four-year master’s or first-class bachelor’s plus distinction-level MSc, or overseas equivalent. A US
four-year bachelor’s is not explicitly guaranteed to meet the integrated-master’s requirement; ask for
individual equivalence before relying on direct entry. MSc is the clearly documented bachelor’s-entry route. F-1
status does not determine UK admission or Home fee status. Programme begins 4 October 2027; PhD initially
registers as MPhil with first-year upgrade. [s1] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Review preparation against Warwick fourth-year mathematics; choose one-year MSc or diploma plus MSc if
further preparation needed. PhD: identify interests and possible supervisors; prior supervisor agreement is not
required. Apply to Mathematics Institute, postgraduate research, code P-G1P4. For university funding submit
course application first, wait for seven-digit ID (up to 48 hours), register ITS, then submit separate scholarship
form. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s14]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Identify possible supervisors but prior agreement is not required for ordinary PhD. Individual research pages
may invite contact; Dervan specifically welcomes prospective PhD contact around November of the preceding
year. Faculty below are a verified relevant shortlist; availability to supervise in 2027 must be checked
individually. [s1] [s2] [s16] [s17]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Submit course form, receive acknowledgement and ID, register ITS (normally up to two working days), then use
Applicant Portal to upload documents, track progress, change referees, resend requests and respond to offers.
University scholarship is a separate portal and becomes uneditable after submission; imports may show a
PDF-view error that the guidance says does not affect assessment. [s6] [s13]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Department: full tuition plus published annual stipend £21,805 for 2027/28, laptop, £2,000 travel and £2,000
third-year study-visit support. Figure is quoted exactly from the opened department page, not silently replaced
by a different indexed figure or an assumed UKRI rate; payment frequency and health/visa cover not stated.
Central Chancellor’s streams: UKRI-rate stipend (2027 cash amount not independently fixed here), full fees,
£5,000 research/training support; possible international immigration-cost assistance. MSc has no general
stipend guarantee established. [s4] [s5]
Years of support [2027 confirmed]
Department mathematics CDT support: four years subject to satisfactory performance. Faculty and
interdisciplinary Chancellor’s: normally 3.5 years. Sanctuary and CSC streams: four years under respective
terms. Do not assume all Warwick awards have identical duration. [s4] [s5]
International eligibility [2027 confirmed]
Department studentships explicitly open to overseas students and cover full overseas fees, but international
places are limited by cost. Chancellor’s competitions welcome all nationalities. CSC requires its
nationality/status eligibility; US Fulbright citizenship is not conferred by US study/F-1. Sanctuary relates to UK
protection/asylum status, not ordinary F-1 status. [s4] [s5]
Conditions and duties [2027 confirmed]
Awards are competitive; departmental renewal requires satisfactory progress. University competition requires
departmental nomination and a course offer before scholarship offer. CSC has separate eligibility and a 21
January 2027 course-offer condition, subject to stated limited exceptions; seek individual advice if relevant. [s4]
[s5] [s6]

Department-led funding automatic unless applicant declares already-secured separate funding; indicate a
specific project if desired. University funding requires its separate single scholarship application after course
submission, ID and ITS setup; documents and references import automatically. [s4] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Department advertises Tim Austin’s probability/ergodic/representation project, other grant-funded projects,

PhD research application: no assessment fee. Taught master’s: £75, non-refundable, payable before
submission unless waiver approved. [s3] [s10] [s11]

Number and type [Standing rule]
Two referees; at least one academic able to discuss academic performance. No friends/family; referees must
answer follow-up questions. Exceptional professional substitutions require committee acceptance. Referee
form can be English or Dutch. [refs] [faq]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
NL Scholarship does not publicly add a third referee or scholarship-only questionnaire. Academic references
remain the two OSIRIS suitability forms; scholarship motivation and financial plan are separate. [refs] [nl]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Submitting referee contact details in OSIRIS sends an email asking the referee to accept. After accepting, the
referee completes an online suitability form, which is the recommendation; this is not described as a free-form
uploaded letter. Use one browser/tab to avoid errors. [refs]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
The instructions permit academic application submission before a referee completes the form. They describe
invitations when contact details are submitted, without requiring final academic submission first. Exact
save-versus-send UI control remains portal-specific. [refs]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
OSIRIS has reference-status tracking. “Busy” means link opened but form not submitted; it is not receipt of a
finished reference. Monitor actual completion before deadline. [faq]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Submitted reference cannot be changed. Before submission, remove an invitation with red X and
resend/replace it; up to two referees total. If institutional mail blocks invitations, FAQ permits a personal
address. No cross-programme/year reuse guarantee found. [faq]

Pay attention to
• SI 2027 deadline is 15 December 2026 at 14:00 Paris, despite erroneous year in one table.
• SI mathematics has no humanities research-proposal requirement.
• The funded three-year SI master/DENS route does not itself admit you to a doctorate.
• Housing is charged and dormitories close in August; grant payment starts in October.
• Faculty shortlist covers closest DMA matches, not all PSL institutions; availability is not promised.
• ENS/PSL academic admission precedes EEF pre-consular processing; do not apply Sorbonne/Strasbourg’s
January EEF academic deadline indiscriminately.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
SI Sciences: potentially eligible with UChicago study, subject to age under 26 on opening day; at least one
foreign university year completed when applying and two at enrolment; no previous SI attempt; French
secondary/higher-education registration no more than six months total during the competition academic year
and preceding year. Exceptional cases require director approval. Master/DENS entry, not a bachelor-to-PhD
offer. Later doctorate needs M2/equivalent and an HDR supervisor. Age and prior France study remain
unverified. [s1] [s9]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics in SI and request referees through OnePSL30. CNE is a separate alternative; exceptional
M1-level entry requires checking department placement. SI selection includes remote scientific and motivation
interviews; use the FAQ and prior jury reports to prepare. Campus France does not transmit SI applications;
visa processing follows admission. For ordinary ENS/PSL master admission, PSL also directs applicants to the
academic portal first, then EEF pre-consular processing after acceptance. Dauphine-hosted programmes are
the stated exception requiring both portals. Do not import the January EEF full-admissions deadline into ENS
International Selection. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s26]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
SI does not require a prior supervisor agreement; department assigns a tutor in August/September. Later
doctorate requires an HDR-qualified supervisor belonging to the chosen doctoral school. Shortlist below
emphasizes DMA matches, with joint/temporary postings flagged. [s2] [s9] [s11]
Portal workflow [Conflict]
Use OnePSL30, attachments, no email/postal applications. The public SI page also retains an inconsistent older
instruction to merge everything into one PDF after an initial form; follow current portal and ask admissions
about attachment packaging without uploading confidential references yourself. [s1] [s2] [s19]

SI 2027 confirmed by signed 17 September 2026 decree. CNE/master excellence/doctoral contracts currently
only 2026 calendars. PGSM 2027 deadline confirmed on its application landing page. [s3] [s6] [s8] [s9] [s18]

Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
MSc Excellence CHF 10,000 per semester (arithmetic CHF 20,000 for two semesters), paid each semester;
student pays tuition, rent and insurance from it. Mathematics is 90 ECTS, normally max three funded
semesters. Room reservation is offered, not free housing. Doctoral assistant 2026 gross salary CHF 55,225
year 1, 56,225 year 2, 57,225 year 3, 58,225 years 4-6, including thirteenth salary month; 2027 rate not yet
established. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s10] [s11]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc 90-ECTS fellowship max three semesters including project; renewal after first year needs conditions below.
Doctoral employment duration is contract/adviser-specific, not established as a universal six-year guarantee
merely because salary table lists six years. [s1] [s6] [s11]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
MSc Excellence explicitly open internationally and external graduates may receive room reservation. Doctoral
assistant employment/funding is available to foreign applicants subject to admission/work permission; external
home-country scholarships must be supplemented to institutional income-equivalent level under policy. US F-1
does not establish Swiss permit or fee status. [s5] [s6] [s8] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
MSc renewal: weighted average ≥5.0/6 and ≥50 eligible ECTS in first year, without exceptions under published
rule; qualifying courses exclude language/admission/outside-plan credits. Declare other scholarships;
substantial simultaneous awards restricted/case-by-case. PhD assistant duties include research,
undergraduate teaching and unit service; salary increments depend on resources/economic conditions.
Preliminary academic acceptance alone can be unfunded. [s5] [s6] [s10] [s11]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
MSc Excellence checkbox must accompany paid/validated December application; no extra documents for
external candidates. EDMA needs programme admission plus a funded adviser position; check advertised
positions and contact relevant groups. Formal hiring follows admission and may require about three months for
visa/work administration. [s5] [s7] [s8] [s20]

EPFL social aid for international students generally only after at least one successful year at EPFL, for
unexpected hardship after other resources exhausted; it is not first-year financial planning. Tuition-transition
allowance is restricted to EPFL bachelor’s graduates, so not a UChicago route. Home-country/external
doctorate awards possible. MSc budget page estimates roughly CHF 29,000 annual living costs plus tuition

master’s requirement to Mathematics. Final-year students can apply before graduating. Mathematics or a
related major is expected and an interview may be required. Nonlocal applicants follow the same academic

completion date remain unverified. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s15]

obtain the RGC reference number, then submit CUHK’s separate full application and any HKPFS supplement.

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Both MPhil and direct PhD are open to a recognized bachelor’s graduate. PhD entry additionally requires
outstanding undergraduate performance or satisfactory postgraduate work (at least one year full-time/two
part-time). Final-year applicants may receive conditional offers. UChicago’s degree therefore provides an
eligible route, conditional on academic assessment and completion; no published numerical Mathematics GPA
threshold was found. A nonlocal student requiring a Hong Kong student visa cannot take part-time research
study. U.S. F-1 status does not authorize Hong Kong residence. [s1] [s10] [s11]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Identify research fit, choose MPhil or PhD, prepare full tertiary records/grade legend and an official
English-medium degree letter, secure academic referee consent, and draft the mandatory research fields.
There is no published Mathematics requirement for a supervisor’s prior agreement. For HKPFS obtain an RGC
reference first, then tick the HKPFS option and enter the matching number in HKUST’s application. Separate
programmes require separate applications, fees, uploads and invitations; no automatic PhD-to-MPhil fallback is
promised. [s4] [s5] [s6] [s8] [s11] [s12]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Explore matches before applying; no prior agreement is mandated for ordinary Mathematics. Contact
mathpg@ust.hk, current coordinator Tianling Jin. Nine active relevant faculty are listed below, with recent
institutional papers; Wei-Ping Li’s newest publicly listed paper is 2023 but an official 2025-28 active grant
confirms ongoing work. Huai-Liang Chang’s old HKUST profile persists while he is absent from the current
roster and a September 2026 university account identifies him at Wuhan; do not assume current HKUST
supervision. [s1] [s11] [s20] [s25] [s32] [s33]

not accept an unfunded offer without checking the 2027 charge and continuing status. [s1] [s3] [s8] [s34]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD admission accepts a mathematics bachelor's degree at Honours (Distinction) equivalent; a master's
is optional. UChicago mathematics is the appropriate subject, but NTU must assess grade equivalence.
International applicants are eligible. Research MSc intake is small and ad hoc; ask the intended supervisor
before treating it as a fallback. F-1 status does not confer Singapore residence or establish nationality. [s1] [s2]

Before submission [Standing rule]
SPMS advises contacting a prospective supervisor before applying, including discussion of funding. Establish
degree equivalence and seek English-test waiver confirmation; prepare academic records, references, written
materials and the required science video. Select the scholarship route early: NPGS closes before ordinary
admission. Use the current portal. Medical examination and insurance belong to enrolment, not the initial
application. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact a prospective supervisor before applying, as SPMS advises. Prioritize Okada for p-adic representation
theory and Lim for modular representation theory; Chan for theta functions/number theory. Other listed
researchers have adjacent algebraic-combinatorics or quantum-topology fits. Current acceptance of new
students is explicit only for Okada; San Ling's outside senior appointment needs clarification. [s2] [s13] [s14] [s22]

Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Eligible to seek the MPhil with a recognized honours bachelor’s or equivalent. Direct 4-year PhD requires a
first-class honours bachelor’s equivalent; HKU evaluates the UChicago degree/GPA, so eligibility for that route
is conditional, not automatic. A bachelor’s plus a master’s is another PhD route. The 3-year PhD normally
requires a research master’s. Interviews or qualifying assessment may occur. International applicants are
admitted; US F-1 status supplies no Hong Kong study permission. Complete the bachelor’s before enrollment
and obtain the required Hong Kong student visa. [s2] [s3] [s16]

proposal guidance says an application without a named supportive supervisor is unlikely to succeed. Obtain
consent from two academic referees. Prepare PDF credentials and a Science research proposal; select the PGS
funding option. For HKPFS, first obtain the RGC reference number, then quote it in the HKU application and
select fellowship consideration. Review current portal questions and disclose AI assistance, including
information retrieval, to the extent required by HKU/RGC. [s2] [s5] [s7] [s13] [s14]

A UChicago bachelor’s normally qualifies for master’s study, not automatic direct doctoral entry. Regular April
2027 applicants must finish by 31 March 2027; a June 2027 conferral misses that intake. Overseas special
selection is for applicants living outside Japan. US F-1 is not Japanese student status; nationality and
graduation date remain essential checks. [s1] [s3]

Choose regular versus overseas special selection; do not combine them for one academic year. For special

eligibility does not require the special equivalency-review route. [s1] [s2]

enquiries were allowed only through 29 June 2026. Ask liaison about future routes before approaching faculty.

Verification and audit
Dataset checks: all 164 dossiers contain all 44 fields (7,216 records), with 1,590 faculty entries, 1,699
publication examples and 4,662 local source-register entries. No missing field text, duplicate local source IDs
or dangling field/faculty references were found in the recovered dataset. Identical within-section descriptions
are grouped without dropping their labels; the complete structured records are preserved separately.
External source audit: all 4,465 main-registry URLs have an individually attributable final outcome. 3,970
returned readable text/PDF or readable redirects; 251 were denied, challenged or unavailable; 242 produced
fetch/tool errors; two returned no substantive extracted text. One initial 25-URL service-level failure was
resolved by smaller batches (24 readable, one reported 403). An additional 29 rendered URLs and three
separately opened correction URLs were checked; some are encoded variants, so they are not simply added to
the distinct-URL total. These are web-reader results that can use cached crawls, not independent live
origin-server uptime measurements. A tool failure does not prove a site is broken; a readable page does not
certify every fact or dynamic portal control. Source types and limits remain visible.
Citation reconciliation: 240 readable individually linked arXiv/publisher records were compared with their
expected paper titles. An incorrect arXiv number on Cristian Popescu's official homepage was corrected
against arXiv and EMS Press; the original number and earlier forthcoming label are retained as superseded
evidence. A publisher-CDN title flag for Robert Friedman's paper was resolved against the primary publisher
record. Older papers and uncertain 2027 supervision are explicitly marked; a publication is not a guarantee of
an available adviser.
Application evidence: 604 field records have current-cycle labels, 4,193 standing-policy labels, 155 prior-cycle
labels, 1,801 unresolved labels and 463 conflicting-source labels. These count fields, not schools. An
unresolved or unpublished portal detail is not inferred from another institution. Long prompts are paraphrased
and linked to their exact official source; no inaccessible prompt is fabricated. No accounts, applications, referee
invitations or adviser messages were sent.
PDF production checks are recorded in the accompanying QA report. Source facts and source accessibility
remain subject to the qualifications above. The retained audit logs and machine-readable dossiers allow each
field and citation to be reviewed independently.
